statusRule: A proposal is not an approval. Open decisions remain blockers at their requiredBefore gate.

decisions.question: Which AI host is the first administered pilot installation?
decisions.blocker: Administrator installation, OAuth profile and MCP conformance cannot be finalized without the host choice.

decisions.question: Which second AI host proves portability without a Core fork?
decisions.blocker: Second-host package and conformance criteria depend on the selected host.

decisions.question: Which competitors and substitute categories define the first bounded D4WN comparison?
decisions.blocker: The comparison universe and exclusion rationale have not been approved.

decisions.question: Which exact client documents and trusted-web sources are approved for the first pilot?
decisions.blocker: No source-by-source purpose, rights, quotation, retention and revocation decision exists.

decisions.question: Which single licensed listening or public-conversation provider is permitted for v1?
decisions.blocker: Provider coverage, rights, cost, retention, aggregation and failure behavior are unapproved.

decisions.question: Who signs research quality, source rights, security/privacy and operations evidence?
decisions.blocker: Named qualified people have not accepted the review responsibilities.

decisions.question: What minimum cohort, suppression, evidence retention and raw-retention values apply?
decisions.blocker: Fixture values are not production policy approval.

decisions.question: Which region and responsibility split define the managed single-tenant reference?
decisions.proposal: eu-region; exact provider and responsibility matrix unselected
decisions.blocker: Hosting provider, region, backup, secret and incident owners are not approved.

decisions.question: Which IdP and delegated/workload OAuth profile is the reference MCP flow?
decisions.blocker: Current OneLogin browser flow is not an agent authorization profile.

decisions.question: What per-brief, per-source and per-installation cost ceilings apply to the pilot?
decisions.blocker: No accepted unit-economics or provider-cost budget exists.

decisions.question: What implementation, subscription/support and provider-usage terms define the paying pilot?
decisions.blocker: Price, inclusions, modification rights and willingness-to-pay evidence are missing.

decisions.question: What DPA, subprocessors, residency, DSR and DPIA decisions govern the reference service?
decisions.blocker: Legal roles and documents have not been approved.

decisions.question: What availability, freshness, support, RPO and RTO objectives are sold?
decisions.blocker: A synthetic native restore is evidenced, but no sold service objectives, production RPO/RTO or support commitment exists.

decisions.question: For every installation, which legacy rows are exported, retained, tombstoned or deleted?
decisions.proposal: Do not auto-promote legacy evidence or insights; reconcile useful brand intent manually.
decisions.blocker: The current estate is verified-zero, but the data owner has not accepted whether and how the legacy schema is removed from the product baseline in R1B.

decisions.question: How will each installation retain controlled access to legacy records after the R1A2 application surfaces and workers are removed?
decisions.proposal: For the verified-zero current estate, no installation records require preservation or access. Keep the legacy schema unchanged in the test baseline until the separate R1B disposition decision.
decisions.blocker: Reopen before R1A2 if any installation or retained data copy is discovered; R1B disposition remains separate.

decisions.question: Which resource, artifact and revocation boundaries govern canonical maintenance before legacy removal?
decisions.proposal: Use the R1A1b contract: 240-second handler, 10-second statements, 1-second locks, fixed row/chunk limits, 256-KiB/100-reference artifacts, O(1) revocation with cleanupPending and mandatory fail-closed artifact projection.
decisions.blocker: The separate verified-zero R1A2 entry decisions are now accepted; reopen installation-specific operations gates before the first installation.

decisions.question: What maximum canonical-cleanup backlog age and incident threshold apply before legacy removal?
decisions.proposal: Not applicable to the verified-zero current fleet. Before the first installation, approve a measured cleanup cadence, maximum backlog age, alert threshold and escalation path.
decisions.blocker: Reopen before the first installation or a material volume change; this decision makes no production SLO claim.

decisions.question: Which measured maintenance window will apply migration 0019 indexes for each installation?
decisions.proposal: Not applicable to the verified-zero current fleet. Fresh databases apply 0019 before work; any import, restore or discovered installation requires sizing and an approved maintenance method.
decisions.blocker: Reopen for any installed/imported/restored database; a concurrent rollout requires a separately reviewed forward migration and must not edit 0019.
